camera.name: Dolly in
camera.text: slow smooth dolly in toward the subject, steady gimbal

camera.name: Dolly out
camera.text: slow dolly out revealing the full scene

camera.name: Crash zoom
camera.text: sudden fast crash zoom into the subject's face, snappy and punchy

camera.name: Orbit
camera.text: camera orbits 180 degrees around the subject at eye level, subject stays centered

camera.name: 360 spin
camera.text: full 360 degree orbit around the product, clean continuous motion

camera.name: Handheld
camera.text: handheld phone camera, subtle natural shake, feels filmed by a friend

camera.name: Selfie
camera.text: front camera selfie framing, arm's length, the person talks straight into the lens

camera.name: Push in close up
camera.text: gentle push in from medium shot to tight close up

camera.name: Top down
camera.text: overhead top down shot looking straight down, flat lay composition

camera.name: Low angle
camera.text: low angle hero shot looking up at the subject, makes it feel powerful

camera.name: Whip pan
camera.text: fast whip pan transition with motion blur into the next moment

camera.name: Tracking
camera.text: camera tracks alongside the subject as they walk, matched speed

camera.name: Tilt reveal
camera.text: slow tilt up from the product to the person's face

camera.name: Rack focus
camera.text: rack focus from the foreground product to the person behind it

camera.name: FPV fly through
camera.text: fpv drone flying fast and low through the space, swooping motion

camera.name: Bullet time
camera.text: frozen moment bullet time, camera sweeps around while the action is suspended

camera.name: Static tripod
camera.text: locked off static tripod shot, no camera movement

camera.name: Macro
camera.text: extreme macro close up, shallow depth of field, fine texture detail

look.name: UGC phone
look.text: shot on iphone, natural window light, real home setting, unpolished and authentic

look.name: Studio product
look.text: clean studio product shot, seamless backdrop, soft box lighting, crisp reflections

look.name: Golden hour
look.text: warm golden hour sunlight, long soft shadows, gentle lens flare

look.name: Bathroom morning
look.text: bright modern bathroom, morning light, mirror and marble counter

look.name: Cinematic

look.name: Pixar 3D

look.name: Night neon
look.text: night scene, neon signs, wet reflective street, cool blue and magenta tones

recipes.name: UGC testimonial
recipes.prompt: A relatable woman in her late 20s sits on her bed in soft morning light, holding [PRODUCT] up to the front camera. She says: "[LINE]" Natural, candid delivery, small smile, handheld selfie framing.

recipes.name: Problem, then product
recipes.prompt: Start on a frustrated close up of [PROBLEM], then the person picks up [PRODUCT] and their expression turns to relief. Handheld phone camera, real home setting.

recipes.name: Product hero orbit
recipes.prompt: [PRODUCT] stands on a clean pedestal, camera orbits 180 degrees around it, soft studio light sweeps across the surface, subtle floating dust particles.

recipes.name: Unboxing
recipes.prompt: Top down shot of hands opening a pink box and lifting out [PRODUCT], tissue paper, satisfying slow reveal, bright natural light.

recipes.name: Before and after split
recipes.prompt: vertical split image, left half labeled before shows [PROBLEM], right half labeled after shows the smooth result after using [PRODUCT], same person, same lighting.

recipes.name: Ad static
recipes.prompt: flat lay of [PRODUCT] on a soft pink background, bold white headline reading "[LINE]" in the upper third, leave the top 12 percent empty, clean premium ad layout
